services.desc: Put tickets for 3+ shows in your online cart, or purchase at the same time through our Box Office, and see the savings automatically appear! This offer is only good for a “set” of tickets to 3+ shows. Example: If you buy 4 tickets to Show A, 2 tickets to Show B, and 2 tickets to Show C, 2 tickets for each production will be discounted; the remaining 2 tickets for Show A will be full price. services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: Creede Rep has three venues available to rent: the Mainstage Theatre, Ruth Humphreys Brown Theatre, and Cliffside Patio. CRT is the perfect location to host a reception, business meeting, seminar, recital or performance. All three venues are located on beautiful, historic Main Street of Creede, CO in close proximity to shops and restaurants. The Ciffside Patio is a lovely outdoor space attached to the Mainstge Theatre. Nestled between Main Street and the Flume, with beutiful views of the surrounding cliffs, it is the perfect spot for a small gatheirg or ceremony!
